item.title: Izumo Dome: A Giant Wooden Dome and Science Fun — Guide
item.description: The Izumo Dome is one of the largest wooden-frame domes in Japan, a vast circular hall near Izumo whose lattice of local cedar timber supports a translucent membrane roof, filling the interior with soft natural light. Built as an all-weather multipurpose space, it hosts sports, community events and markets, and offers family-friendly play and hands-on activities that make it a useful stop with children, especially on a wet or cold day when outdoor sights are less appealing.
